create_ocr_config: create a PPOCRV5ServerRecConfig instance for scene text recognition with default backbone settings
build_ocr_config_with_custom_params: build a PPOCRV5ServerRecConfig with custom hidden_size, depth, and head_out_channels for text recognition
run_config_post_init: run the PPOCRV5ServerRecConfig __post_init__ to auto-initialize conv_kernel_size and backbone_config from HGNetv2
review_config_attributes: review the PPOCRV5ServerRecConfig attributes including hidden_size, mlp_ratio, depth, and num_attention_heads
test_config_from_pretrained: test loading PPOCRV5ServerRecConfig from a pretrained checkpoint using PreTrainedConfig.from_pretrained
